name: VAJRA Formwork
about: VAJRA PP (plastic) hollow shuttering sheets for concrete formwork: slabs, columns, beams. Replaces plywood shuttering. Light, easy to cut, washable, reusable, smooth concrete finish. Sold from Durg/Raipur, Chhattisgarh, delivery across India. Free 1x1 sample on request.
audience: Contractors, shuttering mistris, builders and site engineers in Chhattisgarh and across India who use plywood shuttering today
rules: Never state any number of uses (no '40 baar', no '50+ uses', no 'har 5 slab', no per-dhalai rupee maths, no '1 VAJRA = 8 ply'). The ONLY allowed durability line: 'Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai.'
Ply really lasts about 8-10 uses: never say ply breaks every time / after one use ('har baar toot', 'ek baar mein kharab'). Say it gets damaged, swells, wastes money over time.
Never mention the sheet price, rate or GST anywhere (voice, titles, caption). Rate goes to DM only.
Problem scenes (heavy, broken, wasted, costly ply) show OLD BROWN WOODEN PLYWOOD only, never the grey VAJRA sheet.
No fake proof: never claim lab tests, certificates, awards, customer counts or numbers that are not in the brand notes.
Never name competitors or other brands.
No on-screen 'AI' label (Instagram's AI toggle is used instead).

voice.style: confident, warm Indian site contractor explaining to another contractor, natural Hinglish, slightly fast reel pace with clear pauses

cta: a short spoken line asking viewers to comment PP for details (no price), e.g. 'Details chahiye? Comment mein PP likho.'
